templates.title: Borings
templates.notes: Gives each boring a map location. Without latitude, longitude and elevation the file still passes the schema and codelist checks, but the business-rule check reports one geometry error per boring.

columns.name: boring_id

columns.name: latitude
columns.doc: Decimal degrees, WGS84

columns.name: longitude
columns.doc: Decimal degrees, WGS84 (negative for west)

columns.name: ground_elevation

columns.name: total_depth
columns.doc: Total depth of the boring

columns.name: date_drilled
columns.doc: YYYY-MM-DD

columns.name: trial
columns.doc: Trial number.

columns.name: water_content_pct
columns.doc: Water content of this trial, %.

columns.name: penetration_mm

columns.name: mass_retained_after_wash

templates.title: Gradation (sieve + hydrometer)
templates.astm: ASTM D6913 / D7928 / D422, USCS D2487
templates.notes: One row per sieve or hydrometer point. Percent gravel, sand, silt, clay, D-values, Cu, Cc and the USCS classification are computed; USCS also uses the Atterberg limits of the same sample.

columns.name: standard
columns.doc: Blank = D6913 (+ D7928 hydrometer); or D422

columns.name: method

columns.name: particle_size_mm

columns.name: percent_passing
columns.doc: Percent passing / finer Optional when raw masses or readings are given instead.

columns.name: uscs_symbol
